CITY OF PASADENA
  City Council Minutes
  November 5, 2019- 12:01 A.M.
  City Hall Council Chamber

  SPECIAL MEETING

OPENING:  Mayor Tornek called the special meeting to order at 12:05 a.m.

ROLL CALL:  Mayor Terry Tornek
 Councilmembers:  Vice Mayor Tyron Hampton
  Councilmember Victor Gordo
  Councilmember John J. Kennedy
  Councilmember Steve Madison
  Councilmember Gene Masuda
  Councilmember Margaret McAustin
  Councilmember Andy Wilson

  Staff:  City Manager Steve Mermell
  City Attorney/City Prosecutor Michele Beal Bagneris
  City Clerk Mark Jomsky  -

ORDINANCE- ADOPTED  Conduct Second Reading and Adopt "AN UNCODIFIED
  ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF PASADENA ADOPTING THE
Councilmember Gordo  TENANT PROTECTION ACT OF 2019 RELATING TO THE
recused himself due to a  PROHIBITION OF NO-FAULT TERMINATIONS OF TENANCY
potential conflict and left the  AND EVICTIONS AND LIMITING RENT INCREASES FOR
dais at 12:06 a.m.  RESIDENTIAL REAL PROPERTY THROUGH DECEMBER 31,
  2019" (Introduced by Vice Mayor Hampton) (Ordinance No. 7352)

  Michele Beal Bagneris, City Attorney/City Prosecutor, distributed
  the amended text of Tenant Protection Act of 2019 Ordinance,
  which reflected changes made prior to first reading of the
  ordinance, on Page 4, Section 4, as follows:

  "As applied to notices of termination issued prior to the effective
  date of this ordinance, this ordinance shall apply -to tenancies
  where, as of the effective date of this ordinance, said tenant
  remains in possession and/or any eviction lawsuit has not reached
  a final judgment or issuance of a final order, after all appeals have
  been exhausted. This ordinance may be asserted as an affirmative
  defense in an unlawful detainer action. This ordinance shall not be
  read to prohibit any terminations of tenancy with just cause, as
  these terms are used in AB 1482"

Council Minutes  1  11/05/2019
   Following a brief discussion, the ordinance was adopted by the
  following vote:

  AYES:  Councilmembers Kennedy, Madison, Masuda,
  McAustin, Wilson, Vice Mayor Hampton, Mayor
  Tomek
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Councilmember Gordo·
  ABSTAIN:  None

 ADJOURNMENT  On order of the Mayor, the special meeting of the City Council
  adjourned at 12:06 a.m.

Council Minutes  2  11/05/2019
